+# Stale in-progress diagnostics v1
+
+## Purpose
+
+This specification defines the R034 advisory diagnostic for ordinary claims
+that may have been abandoned. It applies only to native workspace state and
+never changes an issue, an assignment, a lease, an event, or a checkpoint.
+
+## Workspace configuration
+
+The threshold is stored in `.beads/config.json` at
+`doctor.stale_in_progress`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "doctor": {
+    "stale_in_progress": {
+      "version": 1,
+      "max_age_seconds": 86400
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Version 1 requires both fields. `max_age_seconds` is an integer from `1`
+through `i64::MAX`; an event is stale only when its age is *strictly greater*
+than that value. A missing section is interpreted as the version-1 default of
+86,400 seconds for workspaces created before this feature. Any unknown version
+or invalid value fails the diagnostic rather than silently applying different
+semantics.
+
+Fresh workspaces write this versioned section during `bead init`.
+
+## Scope and selection
+
+`bead doctor --scope store` and the default `bead doctor` include the stable
+`stale_in_progress` check. It considers an issue only when all of the following
+are true:
+
+1. Its base status is `in_progress`.
+2. It has an audit event, and its latest audit event in native event-sequence
+   order is older than the configured interval.
+3. Its current claim epoch is ordinary, not leased.
+
+The latest event's timestamp supplies the reported age. Event sequence, rather
+than a cross-machine wall-clock comparison, determines which event is latest.
+
+A current leased claim is excluded even after its expiry time. R002 owns lease
+expiry, fencing, and its recovery path. Historical lease rows do not exclude a
+later ordinary claim: lease rows retain fencing-token history, so the diagnostic
+uses the latest claim event and ends that epoch at a later release, close, or
+reopen event.
+
+## Output and remedy
+
+When any issue qualifies, `doctor` emits a warning check named
+`stale_in_progress`. Its JSON details contain the configuration version and
+threshold, the stable R001/R019 reason code `stale_in_progress`, and a complete
+`stale_issues` list. Every list item includes `id`, `last_event_at`,
+`age_seconds`, and the exact manual remedy:
+
+```text
+bead release <id>
+```
+
+The human-readable line lists the same id, age, and command. A healthy check
+reports the active configuration and an empty list.
+
+The diagnostic is advisory. `doctor`, including `doctor --repair`, never runs
+the remedy or releases an issue.

+/// Load the versioned R034 inactivity threshold from workspace configuration.
+///
+/// The section is optional for workspaces created before R034; those retain a
+/// documented version-1 default. Once present, both the version and positive
+/// threshold are required so an operator cannot silently get a diagnostic with
+/// guessed semantics after a future configuration change.
+fn load_stale_in_progress_config(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressConfig> {
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let config_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io {
+        path: config_path.clone(),
+        msg: e,
+    })?;
+    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| {
+        Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Invalid .beads/config.json while loading doctor.stale_in_progress: {}",
+            e
+        ))
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(doctor) = config.get("doctor") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if doctor.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let doctor = doctor.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(".beads/config.json doctor must be an object".to_string())
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(stale_in_progress) = doctor.get("stale_in_progress") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if stale_in_progress.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let stale_in_progress = stale_in_progress.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress must be an object".to_string(),
+        )
+    })?;
+
+    let version = stale_in_progress
+        .get("version")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.version must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if version != u64::from(STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION) {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Unsupported doctor.stale_in_progress version {} (supported: {})",
+            version, STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION
+        )));
+    }
+
+    let max_age_seconds = stale_in_progress
+        .get("max_age_seconds")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if max_age_seconds == 0 || max_age_seconds > i64::MAX as u64 {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be between 1 and i64::MAX"
+                .to_string(),
+        ));
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressConfig {
+        version: STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION,
+        max_age_seconds,
+    })
+}
+
+/// Whether the last claim that still defines the current lifecycle epoch was
+/// a leased R002 claim.
+///
+/// Lease rows are intentionally retained as per-issue fencing-token history,
+/// so their existence alone cannot identify an ordinary current claim. The
+/// claim event records whether that epoch acquired a lease; a later release,
+/// close, or reopen ends that epoch. Malformed claim detail is treated as
+/// leased so diagnostics never recommend `release` for a possibly fenced R002
+/// claim.
+fn current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<&str>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+) -> bool {
+    let Some(last_claim_sequence) = last_claim_sequence else {
+        return false;
+    };
+    if last_exit_sequence.is_some_and(|sequence| sequence > last_claim_sequence) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    let Some(detail) = last_claim_detail else {
+        return has_lease_row;
+    };
+    let Ok(detail) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(detail) else {
+        return true;
+    };
+
+    if let Some(with_lease) = detail
+        .get("with_lease")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool)
+    {
+        return with_lease;
+    }
+
+    detail.get("action").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) == Some("claim_with_fencing_token")
+        || detail
+            .get("new_fencing_token")
+            .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_null())
+        || has_lease_row
+}
+
+/// A stale ordinary claim returned by the R034 doctor diagnostic.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
+struct StaleInProgressIssue {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    age_seconds: u64,
+    remedy: String,
+}
+
+/// Complete result of the R034 stale ordinary-claim query.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+struct StaleInProgressReport {
+    config_version: u32,
+    max_age_seconds: u64,
+    stale_issues: Vec<StaleInProgressIssue>,
+}
+
+/// Database projection used only while evaluating the R034 diagnostic.
+struct StaleClaimCandidate {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<String>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+}
+
+/// Find stale non-leased in-progress beads without mutating any workspace
+/// state (R034).
+///
+/// The latest audit event is selected by event sequence: event sequence is the
+/// native append order and remains well-defined even when imported timestamps
+/// originate from systems with different clocks. An event exactly on the
+/// threshold is not stale; the configured interval is exceeded strictly.
+fn check_stale_in_progress(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressReport> {
+    let config = load_stale_in_progress_config(store)?;
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let db_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/beads.db");
+    let conn = open_configured_connection(&db_path)
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to open database: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let mut stmt = conn
+        .prepare(
+            "SELECT i.id,
+                    latest_event.time,
+                    latest_claim.sequence,
+                    latest_claim.detail,
+                    (
+                        SELECT MAX(exit_event.sequence)
+                        FROM events exit_event
+                        WHERE exit_event.issue_id = i.id
+                          AND exit_event.kind IN ('released', 'closed', 'reopened')
+                    ) AS last_exit_sequence,
+                    EXISTS(
+                        SELECT 1 FROM leases lease WHERE lease.issue_id = i.id
+                    ) AS has_lease_row
+             FROM issues i
+             JOIN events latest_event ON latest_event.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(event.sequence)
+                 FROM events event
+                 WHERE event.issue_id = i.id
+             )
+             LEFT JOIN events latest_claim ON latest_claim.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(claim_event.sequence)
+                 FROM events claim_event
+                 WHERE claim_event.issue_id = i.id
+                   AND claim_event.kind = 'claimed'
+             )
+             WHERE i.base_status = 'in_progress'
+             ORDER BY i.id",
+        )
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to prepare stale-claim query: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let candidates: Vec<StaleClaimCandidate> = stmt
+        .query_map([], |row| {
+            Ok(StaleClaimCandidate {
+                id: row.get(0)?,
+                last_event_at: row.get(1)?,
+                last_claim_sequence: row.get(2)?,
+                last_claim_detail: row.get(3)?,
+                last_exit_sequence: row.get(4)?,
+                has_lease_row: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? != 0,
+            })
+        })
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to query stale claims: {}", e)))?
+        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to read stale-claim rows: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let now = chrono::Utc::now();
+    let mut stale_issues = Vec::new();
+    for candidate in candidates {
+        if current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+            candidate.last_claim_sequence,
+            candidate.last_claim_detail.as_deref(),
+            candidate.last_exit_sequence,
+            candidate.has_lease_row,
+        ) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let event_time = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&candidate.last_event_at).map_err(|e| {
+            Error::Integrity(format!(
+                "Invalid latest event timestamp for in-progress issue {}: {}",
+                candidate.id, e
+            ))
+        })?;
+        let age_seconds = now
+            .signed_duration_since(event_time.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc))
+            .num_seconds();
+        if age_seconds <= config.max_age_seconds as i64 {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        stale_issues.push(StaleInProgressIssue {
+            remedy: format!("bead release {}", candidate.id),
+            id: candidate.id,
+            last_event_at: candidate.last_event_at,
+            age_seconds: age_seconds as u64,
+        });
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressReport {
+        config_version: config.version,
+        max_age_seconds: config.max_age_seconds,
+        stale_issues,
+    })
+}
+

+//! R034 conformance: advisory stale ordinary-claim detection.
+
+use assert_cmd::Command;
+use chrono::{Duration, Utc};
+use rusqlite::{params, Connection};
+use serde_json::Value;
+use serial_test::serial;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::Path;
+use tempfile::TempDir;
+
+fn bead(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    Command::cargo_bin("bead")
+        .unwrap()
+        .arg("--skip-foreign-workspace")
+        .args(args)
+        .current_dir(workspace)
+        .output()
+        .unwrap()
+}
+
+fn run(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    let output = bead(workspace, args);
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "bead {:?} failed:\nstdout: {}\nstderr: {}",
+        args,
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr),
+    );
+    output
+}
+
+fn workspace() -> TempDir {
+    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    run(temp.path(), &["init", "--prefix", "r034"]);
+    temp
+}
+
+fn create(workspace: &Path, title: &str) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8(run(workspace, &["create", "--title", title]).stdout)
+        .unwrap()
+        .trim()
+        .to_string()
+}
+
+fn claim(workspace: &Path, assignee: &str, lease_ttl: Option<&str>) -> String {
+    let mut args = vec!["claim", "--assignee", assignee, "--json"];
+    if let Some(ttl) = lease_ttl {
+        args.extend(["--lease-ttl", ttl]);
+    }
+    let output = run(workspace, &args);
+    let claim: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    claim["bead_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
+}
+
+fn set_threshold(workspace: &Path, seconds: u64) {
+    let config_path = workspace.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let mut config: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&config_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"] = serde_json::json!({
+        "version": 1,
+        "max_age_seconds": seconds,
+    });
+    fs::write(&config_path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&config).unwrap()).unwrap();
+}
+
+fn age_latest_event(workspace: &Path, issue_id: &str, seconds: i64) {
+    let db = Connection::open(workspace.join(".beads/beads.db")).unwrap();
+    let old_time = (Utc::now() - Duration::seconds(seconds)).to_rfc3339();
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE events
+         SET time = ?1
+         WHERE sequence = (
+             SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM events WHERE issue_id = ?2
+         )",
+        params![old_time, issue_id],
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+}
+
+fn stale_check(workspace: &Path) -> Value {
+    let output = run(workspace, &["doctor", "--scope", "store", "--json"]);
+    let doctor: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    doctor["checks"]
+        .as_array()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .find(|check| check["name"] == "stale_in_progress")
+        .cloned()
+        .expect("store scope should include stale_in_progress")
+}
+
+#[test]
+#[serial]
+fn reports_stale_ordinary_claim_with_versioned_threshold_and_exact_remedy() {
+    let temp = workspace();
+    let workspace = temp.path();
+
+    let config: Value =
+        serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(workspace.join(".beads/config.json")).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"]["version"], 1);
+    assert_eq!(
+        config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"]["max_age_seconds"],
+        86_400
+    );
+
+    set_threshold(workspace, 60);
+    create(workspace, "ordinary stale claim");
+    let issue_id = claim(workspace, "worker", None);
+    age_latest_event(workspace, &issue_id, 120);
+
+    let check = stale_check(workspace);
+    assert_eq!(check["status"], "warning");
+    assert_eq!(check["scope"], "store");
+    assert_eq!(check["details"]["config_version"], 1);
+    assert_eq!(check["details"]["max_age_seconds"], 60);
+    assert_eq!(check["details"]["stale_count"], 1);
+    assert!(check["details"]["reason_codes"]
+        .as_array()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .any(|code| code == "stale_in_progress"));
+
+    let stale = &check["details"]["stale_issues"][0];
+    assert_eq!(stale["id"], issue_id);
+    assert!(stale["age_seconds"].as_u64().unwrap() > 60);
+    assert_eq!(stale["remedy"], format!("bead release {issue_id}"));
+    assert!(check["message"]
+        .as_str()
+        .unwrap()
+        .contains(&format!("bead release {issue_id}")));
+
+    // Even with the repair flag, doctor never releases advisory stale work.
+    run(workspace, &["doctor", "--repair"]);
+    let shown = run(workspace, &["show", &issue_id, "--json"]);
+    let issue: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&shown.stdout).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(issue[0]["status"], "in_progress");
+}

+# Stale in-progress diagnostics v1
+
+## Purpose
+
+This specification defines the R034 advisory diagnostic for ordinary claims
+that may have been abandoned. It applies only to native workspace state and
+never changes an issue, an assignment, a lease, an event, or a checkpoint.
+
+## Workspace configuration
+
+The threshold is stored in `.beads/config.json` at
+`doctor.stale_in_progress`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "doctor": {
+    "stale_in_progress": {
+      "version": 1,
+      "max_age_seconds": 86400
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Version 1 requires both fields. `max_age_seconds` is an integer from `1`
+through `i64::MAX`; an event is stale only when its age is *strictly greater*
+than that value. A missing section is interpreted as the version-1 default of
+86,400 seconds for workspaces created before this feature. Any unknown version
+or invalid value fails the diagnostic rather than silently applying different
+semantics.
+
+Fresh workspaces write this versioned section during `bead init`.
+
+## Scope and selection
+
+`bead doctor --scope store` and the default `bead doctor` include the stable
+`stale_in_progress` check. It considers an issue only when all of the following
+are true:
+
+1. Its base status is `in_progress`.
+2. It has an audit event, and its latest audit event in native event-sequence
+   order is older than the configured interval.
+3. Its current claim epoch is ordinary, not leased.
+
+The latest event's timestamp supplies the reported age. Event sequence, rather
+than a cross-machine wall-clock comparison, determines which event is latest.
+
+A current leased claim is excluded even after its expiry time. R002 owns lease
+expiry, fencing, and its recovery path. Historical lease rows do not exclude a
+later ordinary claim: lease rows retain fencing-token history, so the diagnostic
+uses the latest claim event and ends that epoch at a later release, close, or
+reopen event.
+
+## Output and remedy
+
+When any issue qualifies, `doctor` emits a warning check named
+`stale_in_progress`. Its JSON details contain the configuration version and
+threshold, the stable R001/R019 reason code `stale_in_progress`, and a complete
+`stale_issues` list. Every list item includes `id`, `last_event_at`,
+`age_seconds`, and the exact manual remedy:
+
+```text
+bead release <id>
+```
+
+The human-readable line lists the same id, age, and command. A healthy check
+reports the active configuration and an empty list.
+
+The diagnostic is advisory. `doctor`, including `doctor --repair`, never runs
+the remedy or releases an issue.

+/// Load the versioned R034 inactivity threshold from workspace configuration.
+///
+/// The section is optional for workspaces created before R034; those retain a
+/// documented version-1 default. Once present, both the version and positive
+/// threshold are required so an operator cannot silently get a diagnostic with
+/// guessed semantics after a future configuration change.
+fn load_stale_in_progress_config(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressConfig> {
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let config_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io {
+        path: config_path.clone(),
+        msg: e,
+    })?;
+    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| {
+        Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Invalid .beads/config.json while loading doctor.stale_in_progress: {}",
+            e
+        ))
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(doctor) = config.get("doctor") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if doctor.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let doctor = doctor.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(".beads/config.json doctor must be an object".to_string())
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(stale_in_progress) = doctor.get("stale_in_progress") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if stale_in_progress.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let stale_in_progress = stale_in_progress.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress must be an object".to_string(),
+        )
+    })?;
+
+    let version = stale_in_progress
+        .get("version")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.version must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if version != u64::from(STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION) {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Unsupported doctor.stale_in_progress version {} (supported: {})",
+            version, STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION
+        )));
+    }
+
+    let max_age_seconds = stale_in_progress
+        .get("max_age_seconds")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if max_age_seconds == 0 || max_age_seconds > i64::MAX as u64 {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be between 1 and i64::MAX"
+                .to_string(),
+        ));
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressConfig {
+        version: STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION,
+        max_age_seconds,
+    })
+}

+/// Whether the last claim that still defines the current lifecycle epoch was
+/// a leased R002 claim.
+///
+/// Lease rows are intentionally retained as per-issue fencing-token history,
+/// so their existence alone cannot identify an ordinary current claim. The
+/// claim event records whether that epoch acquired a lease; a later release,
+/// close, or reopen ends that epoch. Malformed claim detail is treated as
+/// leased so diagnostics never recommend `release` for a possibly fenced R002
+/// claim.
+fn current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<&str>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+) -> bool {
+    let Some(last_claim_sequence) = last_claim_sequence else {
+        return false;
+    };
+    if last_exit_sequence.is_some_and(|sequence| sequence > last_claim_sequence) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    let Some(detail) = last_claim_detail else {
+        return has_lease_row;
+    };
+    let Ok(detail) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(detail) else {
+        return true;
+    };
+
+    if let Some(with_lease) = detail
+        .get("with_lease")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool)
+    {
+        return with_lease;
+    }
+
+    detail.get("action").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) == Some("claim_with_fencing_token")
+        || detail
+            .get("new_fencing_token")
+            .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_null())
+        || has_lease_row
+}
+
+/// A stale ordinary claim returned by the R034 doctor diagnostic.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
+struct StaleInProgressIssue {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    age_seconds: u64,
+    remedy: String,
+}
+
+/// Complete result of the R034 stale ordinary-claim query.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+struct StaleInProgressReport {
+    config_version: u32,
+    max_age_seconds: u64,
+    stale_issues: Vec<StaleInProgressIssue>,
+}
+
+/// Database projection used only while evaluating the R034 diagnostic.
+struct StaleClaimCandidate {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<String>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+}
+
+/// Find stale non-leased in-progress beads without mutating any workspace
+/// state (R034).
+///
+/// The latest audit event is selected by event sequence: event sequence is the
+/// native append order and remains well-defined even when imported timestamps
+/// originate from systems with different clocks. An event exactly on the
+/// threshold is not stale; the configured interval is exceeded strictly.
+fn check_stale_in_progress(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressReport> {
+    let config = load_stale_in_progress_config(store)?;
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let db_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/beads.db");
+    let conn = open_configured_connection(&db_path)
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to open database: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let mut stmt = conn
+        .prepare(
+            "SELECT i.id,
+                    latest_event.time,
+                    latest_claim.sequence,
+                    latest_claim.detail,
+                    (
+                        SELECT MAX(exit_event.sequence)
+                        FROM events exit_event
+                        WHERE exit_event.issue_id = i.id
+                          AND exit_event.kind IN ('released', 'closed', 'reopened')
+                    ) AS last_exit_sequence,
+                    EXISTS(
+                        SELECT 1 FROM leases lease WHERE lease.issue_id = i.id
+                    ) AS has_lease_row
+             FROM issues i
+             JOIN events latest_event ON latest_event.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(event.sequence)
+                 FROM events event
+                 WHERE event.issue_id = i.id
+             )
+             LEFT JOIN events latest_claim ON latest_claim.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(claim_event.sequence)
+                 FROM events claim_event
+                 WHERE claim_event.issue_id = i.id
+                   AND claim_event.kind = 'claimed'
+             )
+             WHERE i.base_status = 'in_progress'
+             ORDER BY i.id",
+        )
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to prepare stale-claim query: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let candidates: Vec<StaleClaimCandidate> = stmt
+        .query_map([], |row| {
+            Ok(StaleClaimCandidate {
+                id: row.get(0)?,
+                last_event_at: row.get(1)?,
+                last_claim_sequence: row.get(2)?,
+                last_claim_detail: row.get(3)?,
+                last_exit_sequence: row.get(4)?,
+                has_lease_row: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? != 0,
+            })
+        })
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to query stale claims: {}", e)))?
+        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to read stale-claim rows: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let now = chrono::Utc::now();
+    let mut stale_issues = Vec::new();
+    for candidate in candidates {
+        if current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+            candidate.last_claim_sequence,
+            candidate.last_claim_detail.as_deref(),
+            candidate.last_exit_sequence,
+            candidate.has_lease_row,
+        ) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let event_time = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&candidate.last_event_at).map_err(|e| {
+            Error::Integrity(format!(
+                "Invalid latest event timestamp for in-progress issue {}: {}",
+                candidate.id, e
+            ))
+        })?;
+        let age_seconds = now
+            .signed_duration_since(event_time.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc))
+            .num_seconds();
+        if age_seconds <= config.max_age_seconds as i64 {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        stale_issues.push(StaleInProgressIssue {
+            remedy: format!("bead release {}", candidate.id),
+            id: candidate.id,
+            last_event_at: candidate.last_event_at,
+            age_seconds: age_seconds as u64,
+        });
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressReport {
+        config_version: config.version,
+        max_age_seconds: config.max_age_seconds,
+        stale_issues,
+    })
+}

+//! R034 conformance: advisory stale ordinary-claim detection.
+
+use assert_cmd::Command;
+use chrono::{Duration, Utc};

+fn bead(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    Command::cargo_bin("bead")
+        .unwrap()
+        .arg("--skip-foreign-workspace")
+        .args(args)
+        .current_dir(workspace)
+        .output()
+        .unwrap()
+}
+
+fn run(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    let output = bead(workspace, args);
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "bead {:?} failed:\nstdout: {}\nstderr: {}",
+        args,
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr),
+    );
+    output
+}
+
+fn workspace() -> TempDir {
+    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    run(temp.path(), &["init", "--prefix", "r034"]);
+    temp
+}
+
+fn create(workspace: &Path, title: &str) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8(run(workspace, &["create", "--title", title]).stdout)
+        .unwrap()
+        .trim()
+        .to_string()
+}
+
+fn claim(workspace: &Path, assignee: &str, lease_ttl: Option<&str>) -> String {
+    let mut args = vec!["claim", "--assignee", assignee, "--json"];
+    if let Some(ttl) = lease_ttl {
+        args.extend(["--lease-ttl", ttl]);
+    }
+    let output = run(workspace, &args);
+    let claim: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    claim["bead_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
+}
+
+fn set_threshold(workspace: &Path, seconds: u64) {
+    let config_path = workspace.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let mut config: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&config_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"] = serde_json::json!({
+        "version": 1,
+        "max_age_seconds": seconds,
+    });
+    fs::write(&config_path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&config).unwrap()).unwrap();
+}
+
+fn age_latest_event(workspace: &Path, issue_id: &str, seconds: i64) {
+    let db = Connection::open(workspace.join(".beads/beads.db")).unwrap();
+    let old_time = (Utc::now() - Duration::seconds(seconds)).to_rfc3339();
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE events
+         SET time = ?1
+         WHERE sequence = (
+             SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM events WHERE issue_id = ?2
+         )",
+        params![old_time, issue_id],
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+}
+
+fn stale_check(workspace: &Path) -> Value {
+    let output = run(workspace, &["doctor", "--scope", "store", "--json"]);
+    let doctor: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    doctor["checks"]
+        .as_array()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .find(|check| check["name"] == "stale_in_progress")
+        .cloned()
+        .expect("store scope should include stale_in_progress")
+}

+# Stale in-progress diagnostics v1
+
+## Purpose
+
+This specification defines the R034 advisory diagnostic for ordinary claims
+that may have been abandoned. It applies only to native workspace state and
+never changes an issue, an assignment, a lease, an event, or a checkpoint.
+
+## Workspace configuration
+
+The threshold is stored in `.beads/config.json` at
+`doctor.stale_in_progress`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "doctor": {
+    "stale_in_progress": {
+      "version": 1,
+      "max_age_seconds": 86400
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Version 1 requires both fields. `max_age_seconds` is an integer from `1`
+through `i64::MAX`; an event is stale only when its age is *strictly greater*
+than that value. A missing section is interpreted as the version-1 default of
+86,400 seconds for workspaces created before this feature. Any unknown version
+or invalid value fails the diagnostic rather than silently applying different
+semantics.
+
+Fresh workspaces write this versioned section during `bead init`.
+
+## Scope and selection
+
+`bead doctor --scope store` and the default `bead doctor` include the stable
+`stale_in_progress` check. It considers an issue only when all of the following
+are true:
+
+1. Its base status is `in_progress`.
+2. It has an audit event, and its latest audit event in native event-sequence
+   order is older than the configured interval.
+3. Its current claim epoch is ordinary, not leased.
+
+The latest event's timestamp supplies the reported age. Event sequence, rather
+than a cross-machine wall-clock comparison, determines which event is latest.
+
+A current leased claim is excluded even after its expiry time. R002 owns lease
+expiry, fencing, and its recovery path. Historical lease rows do not exclude a
+later ordinary claim: lease rows retain fencing-token history, so the diagnostic
+uses the latest claim event and ends that epoch at a later release, close, or
+reopen event.
+
+## Output and remedy
+
+When any issue qualifies, `doctor` emits a warning check named
+`stale_in_progress`. Its JSON details contain the configuration version and
+threshold, the stable R001/R019 reason code `stale_in_progress`, and a complete
+`stale_issues` list. Every list item includes `id`, `last_event_at`,
+`age_seconds`, and the exact manual remedy:
+
+```text
+bead release <id>
+```
+
+The human-readable line lists the same id, age, and command. A healthy check
+reports the active configuration and an empty list.
+
+The diagnostic is advisory. `doctor`, including `doctor --repair`, never runs
+the remedy or releases an issue.

+/// Load the versioned R034 inactivity threshold from workspace configuration.
+///
+/// The section is optional for workspaces created before R034; those retain a
+/// documented version-1 default. Once present, both the version and positive
+/// threshold are required so an operator cannot silently get a diagnostic with
+/// guessed semantics after a future configuration change.
+fn load_stale_in_progress_config(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressConfig> {
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let config_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io {
+        path: config_path.clone(),
+        msg: e,
+    })?;
+    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| {
+        Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Invalid .beads/config.json while loading doctor.stale_in_progress: {}",
+            e
+        ))
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(doctor) = config.get("doctor") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if doctor.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let doctor = doctor.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(".beads/config.json doctor must be an object".to_string())
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(stale_in_progress) = doctor.get("stale_in_progress") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if stale_in_progress.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let stale_in_progress = stale_in_progress.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress must be an object".to_string(),
+        )
+    })?;
+
+    let version = stale_in_progress
+        .get("version")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.version must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if version != u64::from(STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION) {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Unsupported doctor.stale_in_progress version {} (supported: {})",
+            version, STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION
+        )));
+    }
+
+    let max_age_seconds = stale_in_progress
+        .get("max_age_seconds")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if max_age_seconds == 0 || max_age_seconds > i64::MAX as u64 {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be between 1 and i64::MAX"
+                .to_string(),
+        ));
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressConfig {
+        version: STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION,
+        max_age_seconds,
+    })
+}

+/// Whether the last claim that still defines the current lifecycle epoch was
+/// a leased R002 claim.
+///
+/// Lease rows are intentionally retained as per-issue fencing-token history,
+/// so their existence alone cannot identify an ordinary current claim. The
+/// claim event records whether that epoch acquired a lease; a later release,
+/// close, or reopen ends that epoch. Malformed claim detail is treated as
+/// leased so diagnostics never recommend `release` for a possibly fenced R002
+/// claim.
+fn current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<&str>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+) -> bool {
+    let Some(last_claim_sequence) = last_claim_sequence else {
+        return false;
+    };
+    if last_exit_sequence.is_some_and(|sequence| sequence > last_claim_sequence) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    let Some(detail) = last_claim_detail else {
+        return has_lease_row;
+    };
+    let Ok(detail) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(detail) else {
+        return true;
+    };
+
+    if let Some(with_lease) = detail
+        .get("with_lease")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool)
+    {
+        return with_lease;
+    }
+
+    detail.get("action").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) == Some("claim_with_fencing_token")
+        || detail
+            .get("new_fencing_token")
+            .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_null())
+        || has_lease_row
+}
+
+/// A stale ordinary claim returned by the R034 doctor diagnostic.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
+struct StaleInProgressIssue {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    age_seconds: u64,
+    remedy: String,
+}
+
+/// Complete result of the R034 stale ordinary-claim query.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+struct StaleInProgressReport {
+    config_version: u32,
+    max_age_seconds: u64,
+    stale_issues: Vec<StaleInProgressIssue>,
+}
+
+/// Database projection used only while evaluating the R034 diagnostic.
+struct StaleClaimCandidate {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<String>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+}
+
+/// Find stale non-leased in-progress beads without mutating any workspace
+/// state (R034).
+///
+/// The latest audit event is selected by event sequence: event sequence is the
+/// native append order and remains well-defined even when imported timestamps
+/// originate from systems with different clocks. An event exactly on the
+/// threshold is not stale; the configured interval is exceeded strictly.
+fn check_stale_in_progress(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressReport> {
+    let config = load_stale_in_progress_config(store)?;
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let db_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/beads.db");
+    let conn = open_configured_connection(&db_path)
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to open database: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let mut stmt = conn
+        .prepare(
+            "SELECT i.id,
+                    latest_event.time,
+                    latest_claim.sequence,
+                    latest_claim.detail,
+                    (
+                        SELECT MAX(exit_event.sequence)
+                        FROM events exit_event
+                        WHERE exit_event.issue_id = i.id
+                          AND exit_event.kind IN ('released', 'closed', 'reopened')
+                    ) AS last_exit_sequence,
+                    EXISTS(
+                        SELECT 1 FROM leases lease WHERE lease.issue_id = i.id
+                    ) AS has_lease_row
+             FROM issues i
+             JOIN events latest_event ON latest_event.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(event.sequence)
+                 FROM events event
+                 WHERE event.issue_id = i.id
+             )
+             LEFT JOIN events latest_claim ON latest_claim.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(claim_event.sequence)
+                 FROM events claim_event
+                 WHERE claim_event.issue_id = i.id
+                   AND claim_event.kind = 'claimed'
+             )
+             WHERE i.base_status = 'in_progress'
+             ORDER BY i.id",
+        )
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to prepare stale-claim query: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let candidates: Vec<StaleClaimCandidate> = stmt
+        .query_map([], |row| {
+            Ok(StaleClaimCandidate {
+                id: row.get(0)?,
+                last_event_at: row.get(1)?,
+                last_claim_sequence: row.get(2)?,
+                last_claim_detail: row.get(3)?,
+                last_exit_sequence: row.get(4)?,
+                has_lease_row: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? != 0,
+            })
+        })
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to query stale claims: {}", e)))?
+        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to read stale-claim rows: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let now = chrono::Utc::now();
+    let mut stale_issues = Vec::new();
+    for candidate in candidates {
+        if current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+            candidate.last_claim_sequence,
+            candidate.last_claim_detail.as_deref(),
+            candidate.last_exit_sequence,
+            candidate.has_lease_row,
+        ) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let event_time = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&candidate.last_event_at).map_err(|e| {
+            Error::Integrity(format!(
+                "Invalid latest event timestamp for in-progress issue {}: {}",
+                candidate.id, e
+            ))
+        })?;
+        let age_seconds = now
+            .signed_duration_since(event_time.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc))
+            .num_seconds();
+        if age_seconds <= config.max_age_seconds as i64 {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        stale_issues.push(StaleInProgressIssue {
+            remedy: format!("bead release {}", candidate.id),
+            id: candidate.id,
+            last_event_at: candidate.last_event_at,
+            age_seconds: age_seconds as u64,
+        });
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressReport {
+        config_version: config.version,
+        max_age_seconds: config.max_age_seconds,
+        stale_issues,
+    })
+}

+//! R034 conformance: advisory stale ordinary-claim detection.
+
+use assert_cmd::Command;

+fn bead(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    Command::cargo_bin("bead")
+        .unwrap()
+        .arg("--skip-foreign-workspace")
+        .args(args)
+        .current_dir(workspace)
+        .output()
+        .unwrap()
+}
+
+fn run(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    let output = bead(workspace, args);
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "bead {:?} failed:\nstdout: {}\nstderr: {}",
+        args,
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr),
+    );
+    output
+}
+
+fn workspace() -> TempDir {
+    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    run(temp.path(), &["init", "--prefix", "r034"]);
+    temp
+}
+
+fn create(workspace: &Path, title: &str) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8(run(workspace, &["create", "--title", title]).stdout)
+        .unwrap()
+        .trim()
+        .to_string()
+}
+
+fn claim(workspace: &Path, assignee: &str, lease_ttl: Option<&str>) -> String {
+    let mut args = vec!["claim", "--assignee", assignee, "--json"];
+    if let Some(ttl) = lease_ttl {
+        args.extend(["--lease-ttl", ttl]);
+    }
+    let output = run(workspace, &args);
+    let claim: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    claim["bead_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
+}
+
+fn set_threshold(workspace: &Path, seconds: u64) {
+    let config_path = workspace.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let mut config: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&config_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"] = serde_json::json!({
+        "version": 1,
+        "max_age_seconds": seconds,
+    });
+    fs::write(&config_path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&config).unwrap()).unwrap();
+}
+
+fn age_latest_event(workspace: &Path, issue_id: &str, seconds: i64) {
+    let db = Connection::open(workspace.join(".beads/beads.db")).unwrap();
+    let old_time = (Utc::now() - Duration::seconds(seconds)).to_rfc3339();
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE events
+         SET time = ?1
+         WHERE sequence = (
+             SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM events WHERE issue_id = ?2
+         )",
+        params![old_time, issue_id],
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+}
+
+fn stale_check(workspace: &Path) -> Value {
+    let output = run(workspace, &["doctor", "--scope", "store", "--json"]);
+    let doctor: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    doctor["checks"]
+        .as_array()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .find(|check| check["name"] == "stale_in_progress")
+        .cloned()
+        .expect("store scope should include stale_in_progress")
+}

+    let temp = workspace();

[32m+[m[32m/// Load the versioned R034 inactivity threshold from workspace configuration.[m
[32m+[m[32m///[m
[32m+[m[32m/// The section is optional for workspaces created before R034; those retain a[m
[32m+[m[32m/// documented version-1 default. Once present, both the version and positive[m
[32m+[m[32m/// threshold are required so an operator cannot silently get a diagnostic with[m
[32m+[m[32m/// guessed semantics after a future configuration change.[m
[32m+[m[32mfn load_stale_in_progress_config(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressConfig> {[m
[32m+[m[32m    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    let config_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/config.json");[m
[32m+[m[32m    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io {[m
[32m+[m[32m        path: config_path.clone(),[m
[32m+[m[32m        msg: e,[m
[32m+[m[32m    })?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| {[m
[32m+[m[32m        Error::workspace(format!([m
[32m+[m[32m            "Invalid .beads/config.json while loading doctor.stale_in_progress: {}",[m
[32m+[m[32m            e[m
[32m+[m[32m        ))[m
[32m+[m[32m    })?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let Some(doctor) = config.get("doctor") else {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());[m
[32m+[m[32m    };[m
[32m+[m[32m    if doctor.is_null() {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m[32m    let doctor = doctor.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {[m
[32m+[m[32m        Error::workspace(".beads/config.json doctor must be an object".to_string())[m
[32m+[m[32m    })?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let Some(stale_in_progress) = doctor.get("stale_in_progress") else {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());[m
[32m+[m[32m    };[m
[32m+[m[32m    if stale_in_progress.is_null() {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m[32m    let stale_in_progress = stale_in_progress.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {[m
[32m+[m[32m        Error::workspace([m
[32m+[m[32m            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress must be an object".to_string(),[m
[32m+[m[32m        )[m
[32m+[m[32m    })?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let version = stale_in_progress[m
[32m+[m[32m        .get("version")[m
[32m+[m[32m        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)[m
[32m+[m[32m        .ok_or_else(|| {[m
[32m+[m[32m            Error::workspace([m
[32m+[m[32m                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.version must be an integer"[m
[32m+[m[32m                    .to_string(),[m
[32m+[m[32m            )[m
[32m+[m[32m        })?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    if version != u64::from(STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION) {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Err(Error::workspace(format!([m
[32m+[m[32m            "Unsupported doctor.stale_in_progress version {} (supported: {})",[m
[32m+[m[32m            version, STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION[m
[32m+[m[32m        )));[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let max_age_seconds = stale_in_progress[m
[32m+[m[32m        .get("max_age_seconds")[m
[32m+[m[32m        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)[m
[32m+[m[32m        .ok_or_else(|| {[m
[32m+[m[32m            Error::workspace([m
[32m+[m[32m                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be an integer"[m
[32m+[m[32m                    .to_string(),[m
[32m+[m[32m            )[m
[32m+[m[32m        })?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    if max_age_seconds == 0 || max_age_seconds > i64::MAX as u64 {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return Err(Error::workspace([m
[32m+[m[32m            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be between 1 and i64::MAX"[m
[32m+[m[32m                .to_string(),[m
[32m+[m[32m        ));[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    Ok(StaleInProgressConfig {[m
[32m+[m[32m        version: STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION,[m
[32m+[m[32m        max_age_seconds,[m
[32m+[m[32m    })[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m

[32m+[m[32m/// Whether the last claim that still defines the current lifecycle epoch was[m
[32m+[m[32m/// a leased R002 claim.[m
[32m+[m[32m///[m
[32m+[m[32m/// Lease rows are intentionally retained as per-issue fencing-token history,[m
[32m+[m[32m/// so their existence alone cannot identify an ordinary current claim. The[m
[32m+[m[32m/// claim event records whether that epoch acquired a lease; a later release,[m
[32m+[m[32m/// close, or reopen ends that epoch. Malformed claim detail is treated as[m
[32m+[m[32m/// leased so diagnostics never recommend `release` for a possibly fenced R002[m
[32m+[m[32m/// claim.[m
[32m+[m[32mfn current_claim_epoch_is_leased([m
[32m+[m[32m    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_claim_detail: Option<&str>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    has_lease_row: bool,[m
[32m+[m[32m) -> bool {[m
[32m+[m[32m    let Some(last_claim_sequence) = last_claim_sequence else {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return false;[m
[32m+[m[32m    };[m
[32m+[m[32m    if last_exit_sequence.is_some_and(|sequence| sequence > last_claim_sequence) {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return false;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let Some(detail) = last_claim_detail else {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return has_lease_row;[m
[32m+[m[32m    };[m
[32m+[m[32m    let Ok(detail) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(detail) else {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return true;[m
[32m+[m[32m    };[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    if let Some(with_lease) = detail[m
[32m+[m[32m        .get("with_lease")[m
[32m+[m[32m        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool)[m
[32m+[m[32m    {[m
[32m+[m[32m        return with_lease;[m
[32m+[m[32m    }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    detail.get("action").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) == Some("claim_with_fencing_token")[m
[32m+[m[32m        || detail[m
[32m+[m[32m            .get("new_fencing_token")[m
[32m+[m[32m            .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_null())[m
[32m+[m[32m        || has_lease_row[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m

[32m+[m[32m/// A stale ordinary claim returned by the R034 doctor diagnostic.[m
[32m+[m[32m#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)][m
[32m+[m[32mstruct StaleInProgressIssue {[m
[32m+[m[32m    id: String,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_event_at: String,[m
[32m+[m[32m    age_seconds: u64,[m
[32m+[m[32m    remedy: String,[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m/// Complete result of the R034 stale ordinary-claim query.[m
[32m+[m[32m#[derive(Debug, Clone)][m
[32m+[m[32mstruct StaleInProgressReport {[m
[32m+[m[32m    config_version: u32,[m
[32m+[m[32m    max_age_seconds: u64,[m

[32m+[m[32m/// Database projection used only while evaluating the R034 diagnostic.[m
[32m+[m[32mstruct StaleClaimCandidate {[m
[32m+[m[32m    id: String,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_event_at: String,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_claim_detail: Option<String>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,[m
[32m+[m[32m    has_lease_row: bool,[m
[32m+[m[32m}[m

[32m+[m[32m/// Find stale non-leased in-progress beads without mutating any workspace[m
[32m+[m[32m/// state (R034).[m
[32m+[m[32m///[m
[32m+[m[32m/// The latest audit event is selected by event sequence: event sequence is the[m
[32m+[m[32m/// native append order and remains well-defined even when imported timestamps[m
[32m+[m[32m/// originate from systems with different clocks. An event exactly on the[m
[32m+[m[32m/// threshold is not stale; the configured interval is exceeded strictly.[m
[32m+[m[32mfn check_stale_in_progress(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressReport> {[m
[32m+[m[32m    let config = load_stale_in_progress_config(store)?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;[m
[32m+[m[32m    let db_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/beads.db");[m
[32m+[m[32m    let conn = open_configured_connection(&db_path)[m
[32m+[m[32m        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to open database: {}", e)))?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let mut stmt = conn[m
[32m+[m[32m        .prepare([m
[32m+[m[32m            "SELECT i.id,[m
[32m+[m[32m                    latest_event.time,[m
[32m+[m[32m                    latest_claim.sequence,[m
[32m+[m[32m                    latest_claim.detail,[m
[32m+[m[32m                    ([m
[32m+[m[32m                        SELECT MAX(exit_event.sequence)[m
[32m+[m[32m                        FROM events exit_event[m
[32m+[m[32m                        WHERE exit_event.issue_id = i.id[m
[32m+[m[32m                          AND exit_event.kind IN ('released', 'closed', 'reopened')[m
[32m+[m[32m                    ) AS last_exit_sequence,[m
[32m+[m[32m                    EXISTS([m
[32m+[m[32m                        SELECT 1 FROM leases lease WHERE lease.issue_id = i.id[m
[32m+[m[32m                    ) AS has_lease_row[m
[32m+[m[32m             FROM issues i[m
[32m+[m[32m             JOIN events latest_event ON latest_event.sequence = ([m
[32m+[m[32m                 SELECT MAX(event.sequence)[m
[32m+[m[32m                 FROM events event[m
[32m+[m[32m                 WHERE event.issue_id = i.id[m
[32m+[m[32m             )[m
[32m+[m[32m             LEFT JOIN events latest_claim ON latest_claim.sequence = ([m
[32m+[m[32m                 SELECT MAX(claim_event.sequence)[m
[32m+[m[32m                 FROM events claim_event[m
[32m+[m[32m                 WHERE claim_event.issue_id = i.id[m
[32m+[m[32m                   AND claim_event.kind = 'claimed'[m
[32m+[m[32m             )[m
[32m+[m[32m             WHERE i.base_status = 'in_progress'[m
[32m+[m[32m             ORDER BY i.id",[m
[32m+[m[32m        )[m
[32m+[m[32m        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to prepare stale-claim query: {}", e)))?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let candidates: Vec<StaleClaimCandidate> = stmt[m
[32m+[m[32m        .query_map([], |row| {[m
[32m+[m[32m            Ok(StaleClaimCandidate {[m
[32m+[m[32m                id: row.get(0)?,[m
[32m+[m[32m                last_event_at: row.get(1)?,[m
[32m+[m[32m                last_claim_sequence: row.get(2)?,[m
[32m+[m[32m                last_claim_detail: row.get(3)?,[m
[32m+[m[32m                last_exit_sequence: row.get(4)?,[m
[32m+[m[32m                has_lease_row: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? != 0,[m
[32m+[m[32m            })[m
[32m+[m[32m        })[m
[32m+[m[32m        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to query stale claims: {}", e)))?[m
[32m+[m[32m        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()[m
[32m+[m[32m        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to read stale-claim rows: {}", e)))?;[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m    let now = chrono::Utc::now();[m
[32m+[m[32m    let mut stale_issues = Vec::new();[m
[32m+[m[32m    for candidate in candidates {[m
[32m+[m[32m        if current_claim_epoch_is_leased([m
[32m+[m[32m            candidate.last_claim_sequence,[m
[32m+[m[32m            candidate.last_claim_detail.as_deref(),[m
[32m+[m[32m            candidate.last_exit_sequence,[m
[32m+[m[32m            candidate.has_lease_row,[m
[32m+[m[32m        ) {[m
[32m+[m[32m            continue;[m
[32m+[m[32m        }[m
[32m+[m
[32m+[m[32m        let event_time = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&candidate.last_event_at).map_err(|e| {[m
[32m+[m[32m            Error::Integrity(format!([m
[32m+[m[32m                "Invalid latest event timestamp for in-progress issue {}: {}",[m
[32m+[m[32m                candidate.id, e[m

+# Stale in-progress diagnostics v1
+
+## Purpose
+
+This specification defines the R034 advisory diagnostic for ordinary claims
+that may have been abandoned. It applies only to native workspace state and
+never changes an issue, an assignment, a lease, an event, or a checkpoint.
+
+## Workspace configuration
+
+The threshold is stored in `.beads/config.json` at
+`doctor.stale_in_progress`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "doctor": {
+    "stale_in_progress": {
+      "version": 1,
+      "max_age_seconds": 86400
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Version 1 requires both fields. `max_age_seconds` is an integer from `1`
+through `i64::MAX`; an event is stale only when its age is *strictly greater*
+than that value. A missing section is interpreted as the version-1 default of
+86,400 seconds for workspaces created before this feature. Any unknown version
+or invalid value fails the diagnostic rather than silently applying different
+semantics.
+
+Fresh workspaces write this versioned section during `bead init`.
+
+## Scope and selection
+
+`bead doctor --scope store` and the default `bead doctor` include the stable
+`stale_in_progress` check. It considers an issue only when all of the following
+are true:
+
+1. Its base status is `in_progress`.
+2. It has an audit event, and its latest audit event in native event-sequence
+   order is older than the configured interval.
+3. Its current claim epoch is ordinary, not leased.
+
+The latest event's timestamp supplies the reported age. Event sequence, rather
+than a cross-machine wall-clock comparison, determines which event is latest.
+
+A current leased claim is excluded even after its expiry time. R002 owns lease
+expiry, fencing, and its recovery path. Historical lease rows do not exclude a
+later ordinary claim: lease rows retain fencing-token history, so the diagnostic
+uses the latest claim event and ends that epoch at a later release, close, or
+reopen event.
+
+## Output and remedy
+
+When any issue qualifies, `doctor` emits a warning check named
+`stale_in_progress`. Its JSON details contain the configuration version and
+threshold, the stable R001/R019 reason code `stale_in_progress`, and a complete
+`stale_issues` list. Every list item includes `id`, `last_event_at`,
+`age_seconds`, and the exact manual remedy:
+
+```text
+bead release <id>
+```
+
+The human-readable line lists the same id, age, and command. A healthy check
+reports the active configuration and an empty list.
+
+The diagnostic is advisory. `doctor`, including `doctor --repair`, never runs
+the remedy or releases an issue.

+/// Load the versioned R034 inactivity threshold from workspace configuration.
+///
+/// The section is optional for workspaces created before R034; those retain a
+/// documented version-1 default. Once present, both the version and positive
+/// threshold are required so an operator cannot silently get a diagnostic with
+/// guessed semantics after a future configuration change.
+fn load_stale_in_progress_config(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressConfig> {
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let config_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path).map_err(|e| Error::Io {
+        path: config_path.clone(),
+        msg: e,
+    })?;
+    let config: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| {
+        Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Invalid .beads/config.json while loading doctor.stale_in_progress: {}",
+            e
+        ))
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(doctor) = config.get("doctor") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if doctor.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let doctor = doctor.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(".beads/config.json doctor must be an object".to_string())
+    })?;
+
+    let Some(stale_in_progress) = doctor.get("stale_in_progress") else {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    };
+    if stale_in_progress.is_null() {
+        return Ok(StaleInProgressConfig::default());
+    }
+    let stale_in_progress = stale_in_progress.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
+        Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress must be an object".to_string(),
+        )
+    })?;
+
+    let version = stale_in_progress
+        .get("version")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.version must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if version != u64::from(STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION) {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(format!(
+            "Unsupported doctor.stale_in_progress version {} (supported: {})",
+            version, STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION
+        )));
+    }
+
+    let max_age_seconds = stale_in_progress
+        .get("max_age_seconds")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_u64)
+        .ok_or_else(|| {
+            Error::workspace(
+                ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be an integer"
+                    .to_string(),
+            )
+        })?;
+    if max_age_seconds == 0 || max_age_seconds > i64::MAX as u64 {
+        return Err(Error::workspace(
+            ".beads/config.json doctor.stale_in_progress.max_age_seconds must be between 1 and i64::MAX"
+                .to_string(),
+        ));
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressConfig {
+        version: STALE_IN_PROGRESS_CONFIG_VERSION,
+        max_age_seconds,
+    })
+}

+/// Whether the last claim that still defines the current lifecycle epoch was
+/// a leased R002 claim.
+///
+/// Lease rows are intentionally retained as per-issue fencing-token history,
+/// so their existence alone cannot identify an ordinary current claim. The
+/// claim event records whether that epoch acquired a lease; a later release,
+/// close, or reopen ends that epoch. Malformed claim detail is treated as
+/// leased so diagnostics never recommend `release` for a possibly fenced R002
+/// claim.
+fn current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<&str>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+) -> bool {
+    let Some(last_claim_sequence) = last_claim_sequence else {
+        return false;
+    };
+    if last_exit_sequence.is_some_and(|sequence| sequence > last_claim_sequence) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    let Some(detail) = last_claim_detail else {
+        return has_lease_row;
+    };
+    let Ok(detail) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(detail) else {
+        return true;
+    };
+
+    if let Some(with_lease) = detail
+        .get("with_lease")
+        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool)
+    {
+        return with_lease;
+    }
+
+    detail.get("action").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) == Some("claim_with_fencing_token")
+        || detail
+            .get("new_fencing_token")
+            .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_null())
+        || has_lease_row
+}
+
+/// A stale ordinary claim returned by the R034 doctor diagnostic.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
+struct StaleInProgressIssue {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    age_seconds: u64,
+    remedy: String,
+}
+
+/// Complete result of the R034 stale ordinary-claim query.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+struct StaleInProgressReport {
+    config_version: u32,
+    max_age_seconds: u64,
+    stale_issues: Vec<StaleInProgressIssue>,
+}
+
+/// Database projection used only while evaluating the R034 diagnostic.
+struct StaleClaimCandidate {
+    id: String,
+    last_event_at: String,
+    last_claim_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    last_claim_detail: Option<String>,
+    last_exit_sequence: Option<i64>,
+    has_lease_row: bool,
+}
+
+/// Find stale non-leased in-progress beads without mutating any workspace
+/// state (R034).
+///
+/// The latest audit event is selected by event sequence: event sequence is the
+/// native append order and remains well-defined even when imported timestamps
+/// originate from systems with different clocks. An event exactly on the
+/// threshold is not stale; the configured interval is exceeded strictly.
+fn check_stale_in_progress(store: &impl Store) -> Result<StaleInProgressReport> {
+    let config = load_stale_in_progress_config(store)?;
+    let workspace = store.get_workspace_config()?;
+    let db_path = workspace.root.join(".beads/beads.db");
+    let conn = open_configured_connection(&db_path)
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to open database: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let mut stmt = conn
+        .prepare(
+            "SELECT i.id,
+                    latest_event.time,
+                    latest_claim.sequence,
+                    latest_claim.detail,
+                    (
+                        SELECT MAX(exit_event.sequence)
+                        FROM events exit_event
+                        WHERE exit_event.issue_id = i.id
+                          AND exit_event.kind IN ('released', 'closed', 'reopened')
+                    ) AS last_exit_sequence,
+                    EXISTS(
+                        SELECT 1 FROM leases lease WHERE lease.issue_id = i.id
+                    ) AS has_lease_row
+             FROM issues i
+             JOIN events latest_event ON latest_event.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(event.sequence)
+                 FROM events event
+                 WHERE event.issue_id = i.id
+             )
+             LEFT JOIN events latest_claim ON latest_claim.sequence = (
+                 SELECT MAX(claim_event.sequence)
+                 FROM events claim_event
+                 WHERE claim_event.issue_id = i.id
+                   AND claim_event.kind = 'claimed'
+             )
+             WHERE i.base_status = 'in_progress'
+             ORDER BY i.id",
+        )
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to prepare stale-claim query: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let candidates: Vec<StaleClaimCandidate> = stmt
+        .query_map([], |row| {
+            Ok(StaleClaimCandidate {
+                id: row.get(0)?,
+                last_event_at: row.get(1)?,
+                last_claim_sequence: row.get(2)?,
+                last_claim_detail: row.get(3)?,
+                last_exit_sequence: row.get(4)?,
+                has_lease_row: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? != 0,
+            })
+        })
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to query stale claims: {}", e)))?
+        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
+        .map_err(|e| Error::Integrity(format!("Failed to read stale-claim rows: {}", e)))?;
+
+    let now = chrono::Utc::now();
+    let mut stale_issues = Vec::new();
+    for candidate in candidates {
+        if current_claim_epoch_is_leased(
+            candidate.last_claim_sequence,
+            candidate.last_claim_detail.as_deref(),
+            candidate.last_exit_sequence,
+            candidate.has_lease_row,
+        ) {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let event_time = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&candidate.last_event_at).map_err(|e| {
+            Error::Integrity(format!(
+                "Invalid latest event timestamp for in-progress issue {}: {}",
+                candidate.id, e
+            ))
+        })?;
+        let age_seconds = now
+            .signed_duration_since(event_time.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc))
+            .num_seconds();
+        if age_seconds <= config.max_age_seconds as i64 {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        stale_issues.push(StaleInProgressIssue {
+            remedy: format!("bead release {}", candidate.id),
+            id: candidate.id,
+            last_event_at: candidate.last_event_at,
+            age_seconds: age_seconds as u64,
+        });
+    }
+
+    Ok(StaleInProgressReport {
+        config_version: config.version,
+        max_age_seconds: config.max_age_seconds,
+        stale_issues,
+    })
+}

+//! R034 conformance: advisory stale ordinary-claim detection.
+
+use assert_cmd::Command;
+use chrono::{Duration, Utc};
+use rusqlite::{params, Connection};
+use serde_json::Value;
+use serial_test::serial;
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::Path;
+use tempfile::TempDir;
+
+fn bead(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    Command::cargo_bin("bead")
+        .unwrap()
+        .arg("--skip-foreign-workspace")
+        .args(args)
+        .current_dir(workspace)
+        .output()
+        .unwrap()
+}
+
+fn run(workspace: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
+    let output = bead(workspace, args);
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "bead {:?} failed:\nstdout: {}\nstderr: {}",
+        args,
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
+        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr),
+    );
+    output
+}
+
+fn workspace() -> TempDir {
+    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    run(temp.path(), &["init", "--prefix", "r034"]);
+    temp
+}
+
+fn create(workspace: &Path, title: &str) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8(run(workspace, &["create", "--title", title]).stdout)
+        .unwrap()
+        .trim()
+        .to_string()
+}
+
+fn claim(workspace: &Path, assignee: &str, lease_ttl: Option<&str>) -> String {
+    let mut args = vec!["claim", "--assignee", assignee, "--json"];
+    if let Some(ttl) = lease_ttl {
+        args.extend(["--lease-ttl", ttl]);
+    }
+    let output = run(workspace, &args);
+    let claim: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    claim["bead_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()
+}
+
+fn set_threshold(workspace: &Path, seconds: u64) {
+    let config_path = workspace.join(".beads/config.json");
+    let mut config: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&config_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
+    config["doctor"]["stale_in_progress"] = serde_json::json!({
+        "version": 1,
+        "max_age_seconds": seconds,
+    });
+    fs::write(&config_path, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&config).unwrap()).unwrap();
+}
+
+fn age_latest_event(workspace: &Path, issue_id: &str, seconds: i64) {
+    let db = Connection::open(workspace.join(".beads/beads.db")).unwrap();
+    let old_time = (Utc::now() - Duration::seconds(seconds)).to_rfc3339();
+    db.execute(
+        "UPDATE events
+         SET time = ?1
+         WHERE sequence = (
+             SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM events WHERE issue_id = ?2
+         )",
+        params![old_time, issue_id],
+    )
+    .unwrap();
+}
+
+fn stale_check(workspace: &Path) -> Value {
+    let output = run(workspace, &["doctor", "--scope", "store", "--json"]);
+    let doctor: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output.stdout).unwrap();
+    doctor["checks"]
+        .as_array()
+        .unwrap()
+        .iter()
+        .find(|check| check["name"] == "stale_in_progress")
+        .cloned()
+        .expect("store scope should include stale_in_progress")
+}

+# Stale in-progress diagnostics v1
+
+## Purpose
+
+This specification defines the R034 advisory diagnostic for ordinary claims
+that may have been abandoned. It applies only to native workspace state and
+never changes an issue, an assignment, a lease, an event, or a checkpoint.
+
+## Workspace configuration
+
+The threshold is stored in `.beads/config.json` at
+`doctor.stale_in_progress`:
+
+```json
+{
+  "doctor": {
+    "stale_in_progress": {
+      "version": 1,
+      "max_age_seconds": 86400
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+Version 1 requires both fields. `max_age_seconds` is an integer from `1`
+through `i64::MAX`; an event is stale only when its age is *strictly greater*
+than that value. A missing section is interpreted as the version-1 default of
+86,400 seconds for workspaces created before this feature. Any unknown version
+or invalid value fails the diagnostic rather than silently applying different
+semantics.
+
+Fresh workspaces write this versioned section during `bead init`.
+
+## Scope and selection
+
+`bead doctor --scope store` and the default `bead doctor` include the stable
+`stale_in_progress` check. It considers an issue only when all of the following
+are true:
+
+1. Its base status is `in_progress`.
+2. It has an audit event, and its latest audit event in native event-sequence
+   order is older than the configured interval.
+3. Its current claim epoch is ordinary, not leased.
+
+The latest event's timestamp supplies the reported age. Event sequence, rather
+than a cross-machine wall-clock comparison, determines which event is latest.
+
+A current leased claim is excluded even after its expiry time. R002 owns lease
+expiry, fencing, and its recovery path. Historical lease rows do not exclude a
+later ordinary claim: lease rows retain fencing-token history, so the diagnostic
+uses the latest claim event and ends that epoch at a later release, close, or
+reopen event.
+
+## Output and remedy
+
+When any issue qualifies, `doctor` emits a warning check named
+`stale_in_progress`. Its JSON details contain the configuration version and
+threshold, the stable R001/R019 reason code `stale_in_progress`, and a complete
+`stale_issues` list. Every list item includes `id`, `last_event_at`,
+`age_seconds`, and the exact manual remedy:
+
+```text
+bead release <id>
+```
+
+The human-readable line lists the same id, age, and command. A healthy check
+reports the active configuration and an empty list.
+
+The diagnostic is advisory. `doctor`, including `doctor --repair`, never runs
+the remedy or releases an issue.
